transcript:
User: Hi — I saw your ad on Facebook about answering missed calls. I keep losing patients after hours, so I'm curious how it works.
Agent: Got it, yeah, that’s exactly what we help with — stopping those lost patients when nobody’s there to grab the call.  

So for your practice, what actually happens right now if someone calls after hours — does it ring out to voicemail, an answering service, or something else?
User: Right now, calls after hours go straight to voicemail, and we miss about 20 calls a week.
Agent: Yeah, that makes sense — and with 20 a week going to voicemail, that’s a lot of patients you never even speak to.  

When those after-hours callers hit voicemail, do they typically leave a message, or do you feel like most of them just call the next office?
User: Most don't leave a message; I worry they call a competitor instead of waiting to book with us.
Agent: Yeah, I hear you — if they don’t leave a message, you basically never even get a shot at them.  

Has anyone ever walked you through what those missed after-hours calls might actually be costing you each month in lost appointments?
User: Not exactly, but I estimate half would book if answered, and each appointment is about $650.
Agent: Right, so doing the math on what you just gave me, you’re leaking around $28,000 a month in potential treatment from those missed calls alone.  

So… it’s a 20‑minute walkthrough where we show you exactly how we plug that gap for your practice — would later today or sometime tomorrow work better for you?
User: Tomorrow works better for me. Let's book the live call slot directly.
Agent: Perfect, tomorrow works.  

First thing — what’s your first name?
User: My first name is Maria.
Agent: Nice to meet you, Maria.  

And your last name?
User: Gonzales.
Agent: Got it, Maria Gonzales.  

So, what’s the name of your practice?
User: My practice is called Bright Smile Dental.
Agent: Bright Smile Dental — got it.  

Quick check, Maria, you’re on Central time, right?
User: Yes, that's correct. I'm in Central time, here in Chicago.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: So it looks like our calendar’s being fussy and not letting me lock that in on my side right this second, but we’ve got your number here in Chicago and we’ll ring you back within the hour to lock in a time for tomorrow that works for you. Before I let you go, is there anything else about your after-hours calls you want us to be ready to focus on when we speak tomorrow?
